about: Use this space to introduce your work. Pick one question you keep returning to and explain what drew you to it.
Give one concrete detail about what you are learning, making or testing now.

research.title: Sample project 01 · Testing an idea
research.subtitle: Example project · Small experiment
research.description: Start with a question another person can understand. What did you want to learn, and what observation would count as an answer?

details.approach: Describe the smallest test you actually ran. Include one design choice and why you made it.
details.evaluation: Replace this paragraph with a result from the test. Give a comparison, an observation or a link to the evidence.

research.title: Sample project 02 · Making a tool
research.subtitle: Example project · Build notes
research.description: Show a task that was awkward to do by hand. Describe who would use the tool and what a successful run should produce.

details.approach: Outline the path from the first sketch to a working version. Name the part you built and a trade-off you had to make.
details.evaluation: Show one real use of the tool. Explain what changed for its user and which limitation is still open.

strings.heroCaption: 在这里放一张自己的图片。
strings.closingText: 写下你希望交流的项目、问题或合作方向。

about: 在这里介绍你的工作。选一个经常想起的问题，写清楚它为什么吸引你。
用一个具体细节说说，最近你在学什么、做什么，或试着验证什么。

research.title: 示例项目 01 · 验证一个想法
research.subtitle: 示例项目 · 小实验
research.description: 从一个容易理解的问题写起。你想弄清什么？看到怎样的现象才算有了答案？

details.approach: 写下你实际做过的最小实验，并说明为什么选这种做法。
details.evaluation: 将这里换成一次真实结果，可以是前后对比、一个观察，或能让人核对的记录。

research.title: 示例项目 02 · 做一个工具
research.subtitle: 示例项目 · 制作记录
research.description: 选一件手工做起来费劲的事。谁需要这个工具？用完之后应该得到什么？

details.approach: 从第一张草图说到可以使用的版本，具体写出你做的部分和一次取舍。
details.evaluation: 用一次真实使用来说明它带来了什么变化，也写下尚未解决的问题。
